rationale: B17 PATH-A — first REAL per-target mutation kill-rate baseline for the workspace (Phase 1 audit § 13 ownership; closed-form audit § 7.6 + agent-based audit § 7.6 both deferred via PATH-B re-bank; resolved here per docs/phases/sub-phase-continuous-ca-rd3d.md § 4.3 Step 2.7). Per-target additive [targets.<id>] config landed at tools/testkit/mutation/mutmut-config.toml; existing Phase-0 testkit/integrity targets UNTOUCHED. Per-target runner uses 'uv run --no-sync pytest' so each mutmut subprocess resolves workspace members through the already-built uv-workspace virtualenv (the specific runner-rework that closed-form + agent-based both deferred). The --disable-mutation-types string,fstring flag is applied to skip docstring-string mutations (the sim.py determinism-strategy declaration alone is 60 lines of docstring per Stage 1 § 3.3); all logical-surface mutation types (numeric / relational / operator / and_test / or_test / name / argument / keyword / lambdef / decorator / annassign / expr_stmt) are retained. Optional third target (RD-3D MMS scaffolding runner.py / analyze.py) was SKIPPED with documented rationale per Stage 1 SHIFT S2: the heat-1D-specific scaffolding is not exercised by RD-3D's inline convergence study + is already covered by the Phase-0 'code_verification_mms' target. Mutation gate remains advisory (non-blocking) at this sub-phase per inherited closed-form / agent-based rationale; PATH-A's contribution is the FIRST REAL BASELINE for the workspace, NOT a gate-flip.
